landing.name: Landing
landing.description: Create an informational and interactive website or application
landing.about: In all interfaces, as a rule, pages that are not too overloaded with interactivity and functions predominate - text documents, description and presentation screens, business card pages, dashboards and various multifunctional main screens of large applications. To create all these interfaces, we created EQUIX/Landing - the simplest in use and functionality, but at the same time the most scalable and universal template, providing frameworks for main pages (with header and footer), side menus for navigation through similar pages, blocks and cards for text and media content (images, video, audio, etc.) and much more.

blog.name: Blog
blog.description: Create a news portal, blog or forum
blog.about: A blog (internet journal of events, internet diary), like a news portal and forum, is a website whose main content is records regularly added by users containing text, images or multimedia. The EQUIX/Blog template provides all the main components that make up such a site: a catalog of news/records/posts/messages/other publications; a separate page for each publication; a page for creating a publication; a personal account with authorization.

data.name: Data
data.description: Create a file manager, admin panel or database management system
data.about: Since any software is most often used not for simply obtaining information, but for some interaction with it and data processing, the most important screens/pages are those that contain functions and interactive content. Their examples are both a simple menu for navigating the site and a registration form, as well as full-fledged file managers, admin panels, dashboards with metrics, database management systems, CRM, CMS, SAAS, etc. EQUIX/Data is our most complex and important product, within which hundreds of components and functions for any interactivity were developed - fields for entering different data, their forms, navigation solutions, but most importantly - algorithms for automatic generation from data in JSON formats of pages that allow these data to be changed in every possible way.

shop.name: Shop
shop.description: Create an online store or application for ordering and paying for services
shop.about: Commercial websites and applications are perhaps the most profitable compared to any other types, so for any company and any project in this area, the speed of development and operation of its result, fault tolerance and clarity for users are critically important. EQUIX/Shop mainly focuses on the technical side of the issue - image optimization, SEO, page loading, responsiveness and clarity of what is happening for the user, and also offers the main components of such applications - interactive cards and their blocks, shopping cart, acquiring form, as well as banners and sections suitable for advertising and other offers.

colorScheme.title: Color scheme generator
colorScheme.description: On this page you can create a color scheme for an application developed using EQUIX. To do this, you need to choose the general tone (hue) of the interface - for example, red or lime. As a rule, the tone of the logo is chosen. The result of generating the scheme needs to be inserted into tailwind.config.js.

about.title: About us
about.description: We create software that significantly simplifies creative work for designers and monotonous tasks for developers, thus allowing the creation of high-quality digital application solutions as simply and quickly as possible, speeding up and reducing the cost of the process.
problemText: Since there is a risk of foreign companies leaving Russia and banning the use of their products in Russia, when developing graphical interfaces one has to rely on

, but none of them offers a solution that covers all stages of development from designing the appearance to deploying the product for user access; as well as allowing the creation of interfaces for all platforms - web applications, mobile applications and PC software.
about.productsText: The EQUIX design system includes a family of products (EQUIX/Data, EQUIX/Shop, EQUIX/Blog, EQUIX/Landing) with open source code, which can be used by designers and developers, and in the absence of a full-fledged development team at their workplace - they can use our services to create software based on EQUIX.
whyUsList: EQUIX allows you to create web applications and software for any platforms (Android, IOS, Windows, Linux, MacOS, IpadOS);
EQUIX includes solutions for all main types of applications - Website (Landing), Online store, News portal (Blog), DBMS.
EQUIX uses the most modern technologies, ensuring high speed, functionality and fault tolerance of applications;

EQUIX takes care of user experience (UX) and developer experience (DX), therefore it provides the most optimal solutions for typical tasks and documentation for developers, which increases development speed; as well as carefully designed approaches based on research in the field of digital device usage for users, which increases the comfort of using services.
